owner_goal: Turn Real Hibachi traffic from occasional visits into a stable, measurable booking engine across Google organic, Bing, ChatGPT referral, Google Ads, and offline booking outcomes.
execution_rule: Complete one task at a time, verify it, then update this file before moving to the next task.

current_data_snapshot.source: GA4 Data API and Google Search Console API
key_findings: GA4 recorded 95 sessions, 70 users, 26 engaged sessions, and 9 conversions in the 30-day window.
Direct traffic is the largest source with 59 sessions and 6 conversions.
chatgpt.com / referral already appears with 14 sessions, 2 users, 9 engaged sessions, and 3 conversions.

Search Console shows impressions for high-intent queries including hibachi at home los angeles, hibachi at home orange county, mobile hibachi near me, and hibachi catering los angeles.
GA4 still reports lead_submit events, while booking_submit did not appear in the pulled 30-day event report.

tracking_quality: booking_submit is the single clean primary booking-request conversion.
deposit_completed is tracked as the strongest paid conversion.
lead_submit is either removed from production tracking or clearly deprecated and excluded from primary optimization.
organic_growth: High-intent Google Search impressions increase week over week for hibachi at home, mobile hibachi, private hibachi chef, and hibachi catering queries.

ai_search_growth: chatgpt.com referral sessions are tracked weekly.

tasks.title: Clean GA4 primary booking conversion tracking
tasks.why: GA4 currently shows lead_submit events but not booking_submit in the pulled 30-day report. Ads learning, attribution, and weekly reporting need one clean primary booking-request signal.
acceptance_criteria: True booking request submission fires booking_submit.
booking_submit appears in GA4 Realtime or DebugView during a production test.
booking_submit includes source, medium, landing page, quote variant, city or ZIP, guest count, and estimated value where available.
lead_submit is removed, deprecated, or explicitly excluded from primary reporting.
GA4 Key Events use the clean primary booking event.
verification: Search codebase for lead_submit and booking_submit.
Inspect GTM and GA4 Key Events.
Submit a controlled production test booking request.
Pull GA4 realtime and event reports after the test.
